Class AggregatorAgent

java.lang.Object
graph.agents.AggregatorAgent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Agent
Direct Known Subclasses:
AvgAgent, MulAgent, PlusAgent
public abstract class AggregatorAgent extends Object implements Agent
Base class for agents that combine N input topics into a single output value (PlusAgent, MulAgent, AvgAgent, ...).

It handles all the common logic: subscribing to every input, remembering the latest value of each one, waiting until every input has been received at least once, and publishing the result. Subclasses only have to implement aggregate(Double[]).

    • callback

      public void callback(String topic, Message msg)
      Called by a topic this agent subscribes to when a new message arrives.

      Stores the value on every matching input slot (so a topic listed more than once counts each time), and publishes aggregate(Double[]) once every input has received at least one value. Non-numeric messages are ignored.

      Specified by:
      callback in interface Agent
      Parameters:
      topic - the name of the topic that published the message
      msg - the published message
